title: Additional requirements based on change of occupancy or use.
officialText:
Fire protection systems governed by this chapter shall
be provided:
1. To the entire building as if the building were hereafter erected, where a change is made in the main use or dominant
occupancy of such building.
2. Throughout a space, where a change is made in the occupancy group classification or usage of the space.
